research_notes: Canada has no single national international tuition figure, so this is one named university (University of Toronto, UTSC admissions page) and is labelled as such. CURRENCY AMBIGUITY RESOLVED BY THE PAGE ITSELF: the amounts are unqualified '$66,110' but this is a Canadian university publishing in its own jurisdiction, and the page separately lists incidental fees in the same units; the currency is therefore recorded as CAD. STRUCTURAL POINT THAT AFFECTS TOTAL COST: Canadian international tuition is normally billed in two tiers, so a multi-year bachelor's cannot be costed at 3 x first-year fee. The page's own table gives First Year $66,110 and a distinct 'Year 2 and up' figure that differs by program ($68,750 Arts/Science, $72,480 Computer Science, $78,160 Management) - the gap is up to $12,050 per year on top of year one. Incidental/ancillary fees of $2,286 are mandatory and additional. Living costs on the same page are ESTIMATES, not government figures: on-campus housing $8,367-$18,022 for September-April and a $6,800 meal plan. HONEST CAVEAT ON AS_OF: the page itself states 'Below are the fees for full-time students during the current year, to help you estimate fees for fall 2027. Accurate fees will be approved in spring 2027, and posted on this page', so these are official indicative fees, not finalised 2027-28 fees. The phrase 'There are some international students, meeting specific criteria, who may be eligible for domestic fees' is recorded as text only - the criteria were not fetched and no domestic-fee claim is made. Also not verified and not claimed: the University of Toronto's PhD domestic-fee alignment (it appeared only in a search snippet of a budget PDF), and the Tuition Explorer per-faculty breakdown, which showed a different incidental figure ($2,100.29) for University College Arts & Science - a genuine minor discrepancy between two U of T systems that should not be silently merged.

claims.statement: The University of Toronto charges international students CAD 66,110 in first year of the Bachelor of Science in Computer Science.
The University of Toronto charges international students CAD 66,110 in first year for Arts, Science and all other undergraduate programs.
For years 2 and above the international tuition is program-differentiated at U of T: CAD 68,750 for Arts/Science, CAD 72,480 for Computer Science and CAD 78,160 for Management.
claims.unit: CAD per year from year 2 (Arts and Science)

claims.statement: International students at the University of Toronto also pay mandatory incidental/ancillary fees of CAD 2,286, covering course costs and campus/student union services including the Extended Health and Dental plan.
